jobs.title: Sr. Developer Advocate, AI and Machine Learning
Sr. Developer Advocate, AI and Machine Learning

reading.body:
The only AI developer-relations hiring in this data is two identical Databricks postings, same title and same date, split between San Francisco and Seattle.

Both are Senior Developer Advocate roles for AI and machine learning, posted on 2026-08-14, and nothing distinguishes them except the city. That pattern usually means one role opened in two markets rather than two separate hires, so the count of two overstates the number of distinct jobs. The function is developer relations and education, which is adoption work: teaching developers to build on a platform rather than building the platform itself.

For AI specifically, this is the demand side of the stack. Developer advocates convert existing model and compute capacity into usage, so the role exists downstream of the infrastructure rather than competing with it for power or chips. A company hiring here is investing in getting its tools used, not in expanding what it can run.

The data does not support any claim about the wider market. It covers one company, one day, one function, and two locations, and it contains no salary, no seniority beyond "Sr.", and no history to compare against. The source list includes federal, aggregated, remote, and European job boards, but these two postings came from a company career board, so the aggregators contributed nothing here. Nothing in the data touches data centers, electricity, or hardware.
